thread:
Maya Chen: Hey team — accepted the Redwood org invite but I can't push to the repo I need for my first task (infra-config). 😕
Maya Chen: When I try to push I get:```error: insufficient permission for adding an object to repository database
remote: error: GH006: Protected branch update failed for refs/heads/main. Required status check(s) "ci/build" are failing.
To https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (protected branch hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config.git'```
Maya Chen: I also don't see the repo under My Repositories in the org — is that a teams/permission thing or an SSO issue? Who should I ping to get added to the right team/codeowner group?
Priya Patel: @Maya Chen welcome! Usually that means you either aren't in the repo team or SSO hasn't been accepted on the right account. Which GitHub username did you accept the invite with?
Maya Chen: I accepted with my work email (maya.chen@redwood.ai) — GH username is mayachen-dev. I double-checked the invite flow and it said "Accepted".
Priya Patel: Can you run `gh auth status` and paste the short output? also check https://redwood.dev/onboarding/github for the common gotchas (account alias/SSO tab).
Maya Chen: pasted output:```gh: Currently logged in to github.com as mayachen-dev (Token: ✅)
You are not a member of the organization redwood-inference (or membership not visible).```
Jordan Kim: That line means GitHub thinks the account isn't org-member-visible — likely SSO or org membership provisioning. @Lee (org-admin) can you confirm whether maya is on the auto-team list for "infra"?
Lee (org-admin): Checking... looks like the invite was accepted but the SSO enforcement blocked team auto-joins because the account didn't complete SSO via Okta. I can manually add them to the infra team and codeowners, but prefer to get SSO fixed so it persists.
Lee (org-admin): I just added mayachen-dev to `team-infra` and to the repo with Maintain role so you can open PRs against protected branches and CI runs will trigger. Try again in a minute.
onboarding-bot: ✅ Onboarding checklist update — added mayachen-dev to team-infra; SSO still pending. Remind: complete SSO at https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso to avoid future breaks.
Maya Chen: Tried pushing again — now the git push goes through to my feature branch, but PR to main still shows that CI status check is required. That makes sense. Thanks for adding the team — I can create the PR now. 🎉
Priya Patel: Perfect — once you open the PR tag @infra and @devex for a quick review; codeowners will be requested automatically for protected files. If SSO nags you later, ping me and I'll walk through the Okta step.
Maya Chen: Will do. Thanks everyone for the quick help!
Lee (org-admin): I'll follow up in about 1hr to confirm SSO completed; if not I'll re-run the auto-sync to ensure team membership stabilizes.
Maya Chen: Sounds good — adding to my onboarding notes.
